answer_1.quote: To assess general knowledge and abilities, we evaluated our final models on the full SuperGLEBer benchmark (29 tasks across classification, sequence tagging, question answering, and sentence similarity) , as well as machine-translated, prompt-based, few-shot QA tasks using the lm-evaluation-harness-de by Plüster (2023a)
answer_1.outputs: The models generate answers to few-shot and zero-shot question answering tasks in German.

answer_2.quote: if not stated otherwise, they are evaluated measuring unnormalized and Byte-length normalized accuracy
